sloka: दृष्ट्वा गाधि सुतः श्रीईमान् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ।अलम् ते घृणया राम पापा एषा दुष्ट चारिणी ॥१-२६-२१॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā gādhi sutaḥ śrīīmān idam vacanam abravīt ।alam te ghṛṇayā rāma pāpā eṣā duṣṭa cāriṇī ॥1-26-21॥

translations.english: "O Rama she does not deserve any more compassion. This yakshini who is sinful, wicked and obstructor of sacrifice will regain her strength by her magical powers ".
